require 'openssl'
require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module PdfForge
  class CertificateStore
    TRUSTED_CA_BUNDLE = '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt'
    
    def initialize(options = {})
      @store = OpenSSL::X509::Store.new
      @verification_mode = options.fetch(:verify_mode, OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER)
      @custom_ca_path = options[:ca_path]
      @allow_self_signed = options.fetch(:allow_self_signed, false)
      @depth = options.fetch(:verification_depth, 5)
      configure_store
    end

    def configure_store
      if @custom_ca_path && File.exist?(@custom_ca_path)
        @store.add_file(@custom_ca_path)
      else
        @store.set_default_paths
      end
      @store.purpose = OpenSSL::X509::PURPOSE_SSL_CLIENT
      @store.flags = compute_flags
    end

    def compute_flags
      flags = OpenSSL::X509::V_FLAG_CRL_CHECK
      flags |= OpenSSL::X509::V_FLAG_CRL_CHECK_ALL if @depth > 2
      flags
    end

    def verify_certificate_chain(cert_chain)
      return false if cert_chain.nil? || cert_chain.empty?
      
      leaf_cert = cert_chain.first
      intermediates = cert_chain[1..-1]
      
      ctx = OpenSSL::X509::StoreContext.new(@store, leaf_cert, intermediates)
      ctx.purpose = OpenSSL::X509::PURPOSE_SSL_CLIENT
      
      result = ctx.verify
      
      unless result
        error_code = ctx.error
        if recoverable_error?(error_code)
          result = attempt_recovery(ctx, leaf_cert, error_code)
        end
      end
      
      result
    end

    def recoverable_error?(error_code)
      recoverable_codes = [
        OpenSSL::X509::V_ERR_UNABLE_TO_GET_CRL,
        OpenSSL::X509::V_ERR_CRL_HAS_EXPIRED,
        OpenSSL::X509::V_ERR_CERT_NOT_YET_VALID
      ]
      recoverable_codes.include?(error_code)
    end

    def attempt_recovery(ctx, cert, error_code)
      case error_code
      when OpenSSL::X509::V_ERR_UNABLE_TO_GET_CRL,
           OpenSSL::X509::V_ERR_CRL_HAS_EXPIRED
        return verify_without_crl(cert)
      when OpenSSL::X509::V_ERR_CERT_NOT_YET_VALID
        return check_clock_skew_tolerance(cert)
      end
      false
    end

    def verify_without_crl(cert)
      relaxed_store = OpenSSL::X509::Store.new
      relaxed_store.set_default_paths
      relaxed_store.purpose = OpenSSL::X509::PURPOSE_SSL_CLIENT
      ctx = OpenSSL::X509::StoreContext.new(relaxed_store, cert)
      ctx.verify
    end

    def check_clock_skew_tolerance(cert)
      tolerance = 300 # 5 minutes
      now = Time.now
      (cert.not_before - tolerance) <= now && now <= (cert.not_after + tolerance)
    end

    def fetch_and_verify_issuer(cert)
      aia = cert.extensions.find { |e| e.oid == 'authorityInfoAccess' }
      return false unless aia
      
      issuer_uri = extract_ca_issuers_uri(aia.value)
      return false unless issuer_uri
      
      issuer_cert = download_certificate(issuer_uri)
      return false unless issuer_cert
      
      @store.add_cert(issuer_cert)
      ctx = OpenSSL::X509::StoreContext.new(@store, cert)
      ctx.verify
    end

    def extract_ca_issuers_uri(aia_value)
      match = aia_value.match(/CA Issuers - URI:(.+?)\n/)
      match ? match[1].strip : nil
    end

    def download_certificate(uri_string)
      uri = URI.parse(uri_string)
      return nil unless ['http', 'https'].include?(uri.scheme)
      
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      if uri.scheme == 'https'
        http.use_ssl = true
        http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
      end
      
      response = http.get(uri.path)
      return nil unless response.code == '200'
      
      OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(response.body)
    rescue => e
      nil
    end
  end

  class EncryptedPdfStorage
    def initialize(cert_store:, storage_path:, encryption_key: nil)
      @cert_store = cert_store
      @storage_path = storage_path
      @encryption_key = encryption_key || generate_key
    end

    def store_signed_pdf(pdf_data, signing_cert_chain)
      unless @cert_store.verify_certificate_chain(signing_cert_chain)
        raise SecurityError, "Certificate chain verification failed"
      end
      
      encrypted = encrypt_data(pdf_data)
      file_id = SecureRandom.uuid
      file_path = File.join(@storage_path, "#{file_id}.enc")
      
      File.open(file_path, 'wb') do |f|
        f.write(encrypted)
      end
      
      { id: file_id, path: file_path, signer: signing_cert_chain.first.subject.to_s }
    end

    private

    def generate_key
      OpenSSL::Random.random_bytes(32)
    end

    def encrypt_data(data)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES256.new(:GCM)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = @encryption_key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      
      encrypted = cipher.update(data) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag
      
      [iv.length].pack('C') + iv + [tag.length].pack('C') + tag + encrypted
    end
  end
end
